title: The notice, from outside
logline: The office door from the yard: the notice on its glass the right way round, and the page still doesn't letter it — the glare does the reserving this time. Two men from behind reading it.

panels.composition: A mill office door from outside with a paper notice taped inside its glass lost in glare, two men from behind in work jackets standing reading it, black spotting on the gravel.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a mill office door seen from outside with a paper notice taped inside its glass lost in glare and two men in work jackets seen from behind reading it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
